nodes.name: alt2
nodes.code:
import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(18.0, 2.0, 2.0)
    .edges("|X")
    .chamfer(0.3)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .rect(14.4, 0.6)
    .cutBlind(-0.4)
)
original_solid = result.val()
mirrored_solid = original_solid.mirror("YZ")
offset_solid = original_solid.translate((30.0, 0.0, 0.0))
result = cq.Workplane("XY").newObject([offset_solid.fuse(mirrored_solid).clean()])
show_object(result)

    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(18.0, 2.0, 2.0)
    .edges("|X")
    .chamfer(0.3)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
